title: Edge site preflight scratchpad
notes:
Quick personal scratchpad for 2-site edge deployment (customer: Acme Health) — mix of VPC prep + on-prem install reminders, gotchas, and actions. NOT a formal runbook.

Top priorities today:
- Validate outbound egress policy with customer (they block 443 to external registries). If blocked, plan: use podman+airgapped registry + mirror images to local Harbor.
- Confirm KMS/HSM exchange flow (customer uses Vault transit with PKCS11 HSM) — need sample config and AWS KMS fallback.
- NVidia driver matrix: target driver 545.xx + CUDA 11.8. Confirm with infra if any kernel patching allowed.

Preflight checklist (quick):
- Racks: confirm U numbers + PDU labels + serial console access.
- IP plan: collect management VLAN / TFTP/VLAN mgmt info from them. NOTE: vendor sent 10.10.0.0/22 mgmt; ask if overlapping with their dev net.
- MTU: customer uses jumbo frames (9000). Set NICs + vSwitch + overlays accordingly. Reminder: Calico MTU = 8950 when using VXLAN.
- DNS: need internal DNS zone and search domains; get FQDN pattern for nodes and LB.
- NTP: customer insists on internal NTP pool (no external). Verify stratum and reachability.
- Proxy: if there's an outbound proxy, get auth method; if mTLS required, get certs.

K8s/container runtime notes:
- They prefer containerd (systemd cgroup). Check kubelet flags: --cgroup-driver=systemd and ensure CRI socket path.
- local registry URL: harbor.acme.local:8443 (TLS). Will need CA import on nodes and in pull secrets.
- SELinux: they run RHEL8 with enforcing ON. Keep it on; set policies for nvidia and containerd. Documented workaround: set containerd runtime options "native" instead of runc for certain kernels.

GPU stack notes:
- Install order: drivers -> nvidia-docker2 -> toolkit -> restart docker/containerd -> verify nvidia-smi inside privileged container.
- Quick validation command: docker run --gpus all --rm nvidia/cuda:11.8-base nvidia-smi (or ctr run for containerd)
- If kernel module fails: check dkms logs (/var/lib/dkms) and whether Secure Boot is enabled (will block unsigned modules). Ask customer if they can disable Secure Boot or provide signed modules.

Networking gotchas seen previously with this customer:
- Edge switch ACLs were blocking ARP probes from our VXLAN VTEPs — required a colo change to allow VTEP IPs.
- BGP flaps observed on 10Gb links caused controller-reconnects; confirm link-sagg settings and keepalive timers.
- Firewall stateful timeouts led to long-lived stream drops; suggest TCP keepalive for long polling channels.

Integrations and secrets:
- Vault path: secret/edge/acme/keys — need read perms for deploy service account. Add to IAM ticket.
- TLS certs: leaf cert + intermediate chain; must import into node OS trust store and into harbor.
- HSM: they want signing in HSM for model keys. Confirm PCI/PHI implications with security; create compliance checklist.

Commands / snippets I keep reusing:
- check kernel: uname -r
- check nvidia: lsmod | grep nvidia; nvidia-smi
- containerd socket: crictl -r unix:///run/containerd/containerd.sock images
- sysctl tweaks: net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1 (but check org policy)

Open questions / blockers to resolve:
- Can we mirror Redwood images to their Harbor or do we need to build from upstream? (ASK: solutions-engineering)
- Does customer permit outbound access to telemetry endpoints? If no, enable local observability gateway.
- HSM integration lead time: procurement has 6-8 weeks — factor into rollout schedule.
- Who owns VLAN trunk config on the ONT? Customer infra or colo provider? Get contact.

Day-of-install quick timeline (personal):
- 08:00: node labeling + BIOS settings check (VT-d, IOMMU)
- 09:00: RAID + OS install image + partitioning (XFS on NVMe for /var/lib/containerd)
- 11:00: NIC config + NTP + DNS + CA import
- 13:00: container runtime + nvidia drivers
- 15:00: K8s bootstrap + taint master nodes + install harbor pull secrets
- 17:00: smoke tests (pull model, run small inference, check latency), metrics export to local Prometheus

Notes to self: keep this doc terse; make a proper runbook after first site completes. Photograph PDU labels and serials and upload to secure project folder. If anything goes sideways, escalate to SRE-on-call (pager: Ethan).

Misc scribbles:
- Their backup window conflicts with our upgrade window (ask scheduling).
- Bring spare SATA -> USB adapter, 2x CAT6 spares, and an M.2 caddy.
- Slack: #edge-deploy channel had earlier config snippets under thread ts/2026-01-11 — pull those.

End of scratchpad. Will trim and move into shared runbook after site acceptance.
